WorkClaw is an AI agent management platform -- OpenClaw for your whole team. It gives your company a fleet of digital teammates called Claws that are pre-skilled, connected to the tools you already use, and running 24/7. WorkClaw is built on OpenClaw, a powerful open-source agent framework. Where OpenClaw gives technical users incredible capability, WorkClaw wraps that same power
